_notes: Paseo worktree lifecycle. Six @lifegames/* deps resolve via file:.yalc/* which is gitignored — a fresh worktree cannot npm install until .yalc/ and yalc.lock are restored from the main checkout (produced originally by design-system-Lifegames `pnpm yalc:publish`).
.env.local (SA_API_KEY, optional) and .envrc are gitignored — copied from main checkout; direnv users still need `direnv allow`.
Astro dev/preview binds fixed port 4321 — do not run two worktrees' dev servers concurrently without overriding the port.

setup: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && { cp "$MAIN/.env.local" .env.local 2>/dev/null || true; } && { cp "$MAIN/.envrc" .envrc 2>/dev/null || true; }
